expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Shared tours keep the price down without losing the sights. Four nights in Osaka then buys you two days of your own.
expert.tip: Use one free day for Himeji castle, an hour away by train, and the other for Universal Studios if there are teenagers with you.

summary: Eight days between two cities on a shared tour basis: three nights in Tokyo with a city tour and Mount Fuji, then four nights in one Osaka hotel with Kyoto, Nara, a walking tour of the food streets and two free days.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; shared full day Tokyo city tour; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip with bullet train return; shared Kyoto and Nara day tour; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
